name: Kevin Roberts

lean.basis: Leads the Heritage Foundation and Heritage Action, which produced Project 2025 for a Republican administration; describes Heritage's role as "institutionalizing Trumpism".

sources.title: Kevin Roberts (political strategist) — Wikipedia
The Heritage Foundation and Kevin Roberts — The New York Times Magazine

current_role: President of the Heritage Foundation and Heritage Action (since December 2021)
summary: Kevin Roberts, a historian by training, ran Wyoming Catholic College and the Texas Public Policy Foundation before becoming president of the Heritage Foundation in 2021, where he oversaw Project 2025, the personnel and policy plan for a second Trump administration. His October 2025 video defending Tucker Carlson after Carlson's interview with Nick Fuentes set off board resignations and staff departures.
